summary: Sr DevOps Engineer, sysadmin background, strong advocate for open-source software, lives in Switzerland, avid cyclist, enjoys building bicycles and motorcycles from spare parts, critical of modern technology and consumerism, divorced with shared custody of two daughters, prefers analog over digital in personal life, skeptical of smart devices, values privacy and self-hosting, critical of corporate practices and environmental issues, engaged in discussions about political and social issues, prefers remote work and flexible arrangements, has experience with various Linux distributions, enjoys music production as a hobby, interested in sustainable living and minimalism.
